subject: frame_bench: set TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=0 for timing
body: Host builds of the frontend now re-run the planner and the variant SHA key behind every encode-memo hit and abort on mismatch (correctness evidence for gates). frame_bench must disable that for timing: env TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=0 in run_replay. Measured just now (no-history): with it, tree encode = 15-16 kins/draw (0.002-0.003 ms/draw host, device est 0.01-0.03 ms/draw); without it you measure the verification (290 kins/draw, 243/366 encode samples in tegu_render_generic_variant_key). Also TEGU_AIR_PLAN_CACHE_VERIFY is off by default (Rust), leave it.
